eligibility_rule.multiple_testing: Holm correction over four task-level raw-Ridge Spearman tests
eligibility_rule.primary: positive Holm-significant Spearman AND paired-bootstrap MSE improvement over train-mean baseline
eligibility_rule.secondary: positive Holm-significant Spearman AND paired-bootstrap MAE improvement, without MSE improvement, over train-mean baseline

primary_policy.name: conservative_summary80
primary_policy.description: Apply 80% selective coverage only to PRIMARY-ELIGIBLE summary questions; answer all factoid, yes/no, and list questions.

secondary_policy.name: expanded_summary_factoid80
secondary_policy.description: Apply 80% selective coverage to summary and SECONDARY-ELIGIBLE factoid questions; answer all yes/no and list questions.

locked_test_application: Rank locked-test questions within each task using the frozen final task-specific raw Ridge score. Apply the prespecified coverage fractions. Do not use locked-test labels for ranking, coverage selection, or threshold tuning.
next_phase: Phase 5 — one-time locked internal test evaluation
